fields.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Aphelios''' switches between his {{as|main weapon}} and {{as|off-hand}} weapon over {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
fields.notes:
* Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Switching does not interrupt '''any''' commands '''Aphelios''' was issued before or during ''Phase''.
